Sandbox_DF_BanBoxEnabled_tooltip: Master switch for the item BanBox engine (default ON). When on, any item types registered by a ban-list mod (such as the optional BBLibrary submod, or your own) are stripped from loot distribution at server start so no new copies spawn. Prevention only - items already in the world are not removed. With no ban-list mod enabled the engine does nothing. Changes take effect on the next server restart.
Sandbox_DF_BanBoxConfiscateOnLogin_toolt: Default OFF. When on, a player connecting has any banned items removed from their CARRIED inventory (main, worn, and bags) - the one copy prevention can't reach. The player is told and an audit line is logged for staff; the player is never auto-punished. Bounded to the connecting player only - base storage, vehicles and the wider world are never touched. Requires the BanBox to be enabled above.
Sandbox_DF_BanBoxDebug_tooltip: Default OFF. Verbose BanBox tracing to the server log (login poll, per-player wait state, scan counts). Off keeps the log clean - only the confiscation audit line is still written. Turn on only when diagnosing the BanBox.
